metrics.name: global_median_dwell_time_days
metrics.notes: The global median dwell time (time from compromise to detection) decreased to 10 days.

metrics.name: externally_detected_breaches_ratio
metrics.notes: 53% of intrusions were detected by external parties, indicating continued challenges in internal detection capabilities.

insights: Espionage remains a primary motivation for state-sponsored threat actors. The report highlights China-nexus actors' focus on exploiting edge devices and virtualization software.

metrics.name: nation_state_targeting_ci_ratio
metrics.notes: Almost 70% of nation-state activity observed by Microsoft from mid-2022 to mid-2023 targeted critical infrastructure sectors.

metrics.name: password_attacks_per_second
metrics.notes: Microsoft observed an average of more than 4,000 password-based attacks per second, a significant increase year-over-year.

insights: Nation-state actors are increasingly blending cyberattacks with influence operations. Russia, Iran, China, and North Korea remain the most active state actors, targeting organizations for intelligence gathering and disruption.
